description: Hash the raw joined law lines instead of the whitespace-normalised text, so re-wrapping or re-indenting changes the hash

edits.find:
const text = normalise(lines.join(" "));
    return { text, hash: hashLaw(text) };
edits.replace:
const raw = lines.join("\n");
    return { text: normalise(raw), hash: new Bun.CryptoHasher("sha256").update(raw).digest("hex").slice(0, 8) };
